name: branding-lime-a-app-icon-and-store-listing
title: Slashed-A monogram as app icon in dark green and lime with store listing and glass tile
whatItIs: A grey board with three rounded panels: a blurred house background with a white App Store-style page for 'ARC: Real Estate Investing', a pair of icons (white A on dark green, dark A on lime), and a lime A on a refractive glass tile over a timber-slatted facade.
whatItMeans: Fresh and confident; lime on dark green is instantly recognisable and the glass tile feels premium.
techniques: Show the icon in dark and lime versions side by side.
Place the mark on a refractive glass tile over real architecture.
Present a realistic store listing to prove the icon in context.
Blur the background to keep focus on the UI card.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent tile that bends and tints the scene behind it.
Two colour variants of the same icon.
A facsimile of an app store page.
An out-of-focus photo behind a UI card.
